about_short_description.short_description: Elayne enables families to create generational wealth by streamlining estate planning and settlements on a single, integrated platform.

product.name: Family Network
product.description: A platform feature allowing family members to join for free, share estate plans, and stay connected with shared documents and trusted contacts.

product.name: AI-Enabled Guidance
product.description: An automated system providing tailored estate planning recommendations based on uploaded documents and connected accounts.

product.name: Loss Navigation
product.description: A service offering a personalized roadmap and dedicated human concierge to guide families through estate settlement after a loss.

product.name: Financial Management
product.description: A tool to discover, protect, and access financial accounts after a loved one’s death, including filing claims and automating distributions.

product.name: Smart Estate Planning
product.description: An automated estate and financial planning solution that aligns legacy plans with life milestones and changes.

product.name: Guidance After Loss
product.description: A service managing financial, legal, and practical estate settlement details after a loved one’s death to reduce burden on families.
